about.title: About
about.seoDesc: Il Bel Paese: the first mapping, promotion and research platform that legitimises Italy's independent artistic realities.
about.p1_html: Il Bel Paese is the first mapping, promotion and research platform that legitimises independent Italian artistic and project-based realities.
about.p2_html: Through a dynamic showcase and a historical archive, the project systematises these experiences to foster networks and narrow the gap between the independent scene and the institutional system.
about.p3: We believe independent realities — physical spaces, those without a venue, and those no longer in existence — are a collective cultural heritage that deserves recognition, memory and tools to dialogue with the rest of the art system.
about.missionDesc: To legitimise, network and give voice to Italy's independent artistic realities through mapping, promotion and research.
about.visionDesc: An ecosystem where the independent scene and the institutional world meet as equals, recognising one another as part of the same cultural landscape.

what.title: What We
what.intro: Our work rests on three pillars — mapping, promotion and research — designed to legitimise the independent scene and connect it with the institutional system.
what.intro_html: Our work rests on three pillars — mapping, promotion and research — designed to legitimise the independent scene and connect it with the institutional system.
what.seoDesc: Mapping, promotion and research: the three pillars through which Il Bel Paese legitimises the Italian independent art scene.

mapping.title: Mapping
mapping.desc: We identify and categorise Italy's independent artistic realities into three families: Spaces (with a physical venue), Spaces without a space (itinerant, digital, nomadic) and Spaces that were (historical archive of concluded experiences).

promotion.title: Promotion
promotion.desc: We give visibility to mapped realities through a dynamic showcase, an editorial magazine and an open replies space where different voices debate the issues shaping the independent scene.

research.title: Research
research.desc: We conduct research, gather data and produce content to interpret and document the transformations of Italy's art scene.

methodDescs.listen: We surface realities through tip-offs, field research and direct dialogue with the scene.
methodDescs.map: We verify, geolocate and categorise every experience using shared criteria.
methodDescs.tell: We publish profiles, articles and debates to provide context and visibility.
methodDescs.update: An annual review of mapped realities to keep the data current.

what.whyText: Because independent realities often fall under the radar of institutions, official databases and funding routes. Documenting them, telling their stories and connecting them means restoring the legitimacy they deserve and enriching the country's cultural heritage.
what.ctaText: If you represent an independent artistic reality, are a researcher or an institutional partner, write to us to join the map or the magazine.
